speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue. I also have Appearance of pale skin, Presence of multiple pinpoint, red, nonblanching spots on extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia

The presence of pancytopenia (low platelets and hemoglobin) with a drastically elevated white blood cell count, combined with new pinpoint red spots (petechiae), strongly points to a leukemia rather than iron deficiency. Have you noticed any unusual bruising, gum swelling, or bone pain in addition to the fatigue?
